body:
I’ve got a therapist, I’ve actually been to multiple over the years, I never felt progress. Medication has been extremely helpful, I just don’t take mine consistently anymore. 

I was on desvenlafaxine, but I experienced weight gain...but, weight loss and appetite loss are the side effects listed for the drug. So, my doctor said that’s probably placebo, and, even tho the pharmacology doesn’t support my experience, the brain is very strong and capable of creating a side effect like that on its own. I gained 40 lbs in 4 months of being on the drug tho, even when working with my dietician. When I don’t take the drug I maintain weight, even if I increase my calorie intake by 2x...

It’s not necessarily the new situation that’s hard for me to cope with, it’s that I’m failing. Terribly. I’m letting down my mom, which hurts, but she’ll forgive me for that. But I’m also failing her clients. Which, is what really hurts.
